data.name: One Day To Live
data.detailed_description:
One Day To Live is a post-apocalyptic VR zombie survival game where every sunrise could be your last.

The Outbreak

What began as a controllable virus spiraled into apocalypse when the vaccine's efficacy diminished. Governments collapsed, cities fell silent, and billions succumbed. Now, scattered survivors like you scavenge the remnants of civilization, racing against the clock to secure your next injection. The infected, once friends, family, and strangers, roam in relentless packs, their humanity lost to the insatiable hunger. Will you outlast the dawn, or become one of them?





Core Gameplay Features

  • Time-Critical Survival: Your life hangs on a 24-hour cycle. Track your infection levels in real-time as they increase, forcing desperate decisions. Raid a fortified military facility for boosters, or risk a detour through zombie-infested homes? Every choice impacts your fate.

  • Open World: Explore a vast wasteland spanning abandoned neighborhoods, overgrown forests, industrial ruins, and hidden bunkers. Weather events, day-night cycles, and evolving zombie behaviors keep the environment unpredictable and deadly.

  • Resource Management: Scavenge for medical supplies, weapons, and boosters. 

  • Intense Combat and Stealth: Face hordes with improvised tactics or clever distractions. Go loud with explosions and full-auto, or slip through shadows to avoid detection. Mutated zombie variants add layers of horror, from fast-runners to armored brutes.

  • Permadeath and Replayability: Death is permanent, but each run unlocks new starting locations and world variations. Difficulty levels amp up the tension with shorter infection windows, fewer items, and super tough zombies.

  • Multiplayer CO-OP or Free-For-All: Play with friends, or enemies...

  • Exclusively for Virtual Reality: OpenXR, supports all headsets and controllers.

data.short_description: The entire world is infected. Many have already turned. The booster shots can only hold off the infection for 24 hours at a time now. You only have one day to live, will you survive?

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Core i5-6600K / AMD Ryzen 5 1600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060 3GB / AMD Radeon RX 480 4GB
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 8 GB available space
  • VR Support: SteamVR or OpenXR. Room Scale 2m by 1.5m area required
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i9-9900K / AMD Ryzen 9 3900X
  • Memory: 12 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 2070 / AMD Radeon RX 5700 XT
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 8 GB available space
  • VR Support: SteamVR or OpenXR. Room Scale 2m by 1.5m area required

content_descriptors.notes: Killing zombies and monsters with firearms, consuming pills and vaccine boosters to slow the infection.
